Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
It appears that the Shadow Court Satyr's text has changed in
3E, and I'm not sure if this is a functional change or not.

===
When the Satyr enters play, you may put a combat card from your
hand on him. Once each combat, the Satyr may use the ability of
that card as if played from your hand. If the card requires a
vampire (e.g., costs blood or requires a Discipline), he may
use it as a vampire with the basic level of the Discipline
(if any).
===

Old text only referred to cards requiring a *Discipline*.

So, under the new wording, does this mean:
a) Shadow Court Satyr can use a non-discipline combat card
that requires a vampire? (i.e. Taste of Vitae)

a) Shadow Court Satyr can use a non-discipline combat card
that has a blood cost? (i.e. Tortured Confession)

b) Shadow Court Satyr can use a combat card that requires a
clan? (i.e. Raking Talons)

BONUS QUESTION:

c) In a Limited format, can Shadow Court Satyr use draftferiors
on combat cards (as long as the draftferior meets the above
requirements)?

> that card as if played from your hand. If the card requires a
> vampire (e.g., costs blood or requires a Discipline), he may
> use it as a vampire with the basic level of the Discipline
> (if any).
> ===
>
> Old text only referred to cards requiring a *Discipline*.
>
> So, under the new wording, does this mean:
> a) Shadow Court Satyr can use a non-discipline combat card
> that requires a vampire? (i.e. Taste of Vitae)
>
> a) Shadow Court Satyr can use a non-discipline combat card
> that has a blood cost? (i.e. Tortured Confession)

These two a)'s are the same question, and are answered by card text in
the affirmative.

> b) Shadow Court Satyr can use a combat card that requires a
> clan? (i.e. Raking Talons)

No. Card text allows Disipline mimicking, but not clan, title,
capacity, or other attribute (like Anarchness) mimicking.

> BONUS QUESTION:
>
> c) In a Limited format, can Shadow Court Satyr use draftferiors
> on combat cards (as long as the draftferior meets the above
> requirements)?

The question is: "Can draftferior abilities be used in limited format?"
The answer is inescapable.

To follow up on Shadow Court Satyr wording... does the "once each
combat" wording apply only to a combat the SCS is IN? i.e. if I have a
handful of SCS each with heaven's gate, which is usable by a vampire
outside of combat, can the SCS's "Heaven's Gate" each other once per
combat (either at nec or obe) from outside of the combat, potentially
leading to a SCS playing heaven's gate mutiple times in a turn, but
only once per each combat.

Heaven's Gate
Only usable by a ready untapped vampire not involved in combat.

[nec] Prevent 1 damage to an ally in combat.

[obe] Only usable when an ally is burned in combat. Move that ally to
his or her controller's uncontrolled region (controlled, but not ready)
instead. Put 1 life on the ally from the blood bank if he or she has no
life.

[OBE] As [obe] above, but add up to 2 life to the ally, not to exceed
his or her starting amount.

Thanks,
Chris
